Owner, 2026-10-30: "What we have also done on structuring a human readable repo is also important. We have recently spent time discussing how to structure a repo for humans. See if we can collect that too.

It looks like we need to be able to keep an ongoing research into srs use area in the programme and make sure that it's all findable from context.."
